describe.RPC: Create an RPC instance using a duplex `stream`. `onrequest` is an optional callback run when a remote request is received. This is where processing and responding to an RPC request happens. `onrequest` receives a `RPCIncomingRequest` as an argument, for example:
describe.request: Create a request for `command`. `command` is a unique number that should be used to differentiate different requests on the remote end. Returns a `RPCOutgoingRequest`.
describe.command: The command that the request was created with. A command is a unique number.
describe.sent: A boolean for whether the request has been sent.
describe.received: A boolean for whether the request has received a reply.
describe.send: Send the request with the provided `data`. `data` can be a buffer or a string which will be encoded using `encoding`.
describe.reply: Await the reply from the remote end to the request. `encoding` can be defined for decoding the response `data` buffer back into a string.
describe.createRequestStream: Create a [`Writable`](https://github.com/mafintosh/streamx#writable-stream) stream for sending data with the request.
describe.createResponseStream: Create a [`Readable`](https://github.com/mafintosh/streamx#readable-stream) stream for receiving data in reply to the request.
describe.data: The data buffer sent with the request.
